registers.title: General Registers
rows: Accumulator: multiply, divide, I/O, string data
Count: loops, string repeats, shift counts (CL)
Data: the high half of multiply / divide, the I/O port
Stack pointer (as a base it takes a SIB byte)
Frame pointer (as a base it takes a displacement)
As a base it takes a SIB byte, as RSP does
As a base it takes a displacement, as RBP does

registers.title: REX Prefix (0100 W R X B)
rows: The ModRM reg field's fourth bit
The ModRM r/m, SIB base or opcode register's fourth bit
Any REX makes byte registers 4-7 SPL, BPL, SIL, DIL instead of AH, CH, DH, BH

registers.title: Segment Registers (sreg)
rows: Data segment: the default for memory
Extra segment (thread data on many systems)
Extra segment (thread / CPU data on many systems)

registers.title: Control Registers (cr)
rows: PE (protected mode), PG (paging), WP, CD, NW, TS, EM, MP
The address of the last page fault
PAE, PSE, PGE, VME, ... (CR8, the task priority, takes REX.R: not on this sheet)

registers.title: SIB: base + index × scale
rows: 100 (no REX.X): no index, written eiz / riz with scale 1 or left out
101 with mod 00: no base, a 32 bit displacement

registers.title: Flags
rows: Resume: no debug fault on the next instruction
